summary: Frontend-only verification of new StudentDetailSheet feature on Admin tab (viewport 390x844). Admin login worked; seeded 3 test students (Sheet Delete User, Row Delete User, Photo Student with 1x1 PNG) via API. Validated: tapping student-row-* opens student-detail-sheet, student-sheet-name matches, type + 'Adm <no>' tags render, all 3 quick actions (call/whatsapp/email) and all 8 detail rows (Father's Name, Date of Birth, Class, Phone, WhatsApp, Email, Address, Registered On) show matching values. student-sheet-close and student-sheet-backdrop both close the sheet. Delete-from-sheet closes sheet, shows admin-toast 'Deleted Sheet Delete User', removes the row, and decrements stat-students (6 -> 5). Row-level delete-{id} works independently without opening the sheet. student-sheet-photo renders a non-zero sized image element for a student registered with photo_base64. Cleanup via DELETE /api/admin/students/{id} and DELETE /api/admin/admissions/{no} completed; no leftover test data. All 5 scenarios in the review request PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: StudentDetailSheet.tsx and admin.tsx are clean and well-structured. Minor note: row Pressable's inner delete button relies on e.stopPropagation?.(); on React Native Web this works, but on native RN Pressable the synthetic event lacks stopPropagation and both the row (opens sheet) and the delete action fire simultaneously. Web preview test confirmed row-level delete does NOT open the sheet, but main agent may want to validate on native build or restructure (e.g., move delete out of the pressable row).
seed_data_creation: Seeded admissions TSHEET-DEL-001, TROW-DEL-002, TPHOTO-003 and registered 3 matching students; all cleaned up afterwards (students count unchanged from baseline).
